mentions.h: The start of the Belgrave 800 metre championship for 1991

mentions.note: appeared in the play Blind Side

official.h: 31 year-old record goes in NJL match 1

photos.c: The start of the Belgrave 800 metre championship for 1991. From left to right: Nigel Clarke, Jon Coy, Mark Anderson, Brandon Reid, Gavin Teahan, Colin Bond and Tony Stone.
Trevor Williams attempts to hang on to Jon Coy; both were off 8:30 but Jon is already putting the boot in before the end of Lauriston.

The senior team poses at Petersham prior to setting out on the first of the 1991/92 Surrey League cross country races. Back row (left to right): Colin Pearson, Gerry Adams, Chris Taplin, Paul Roche, Tony Stone, Mike Hayes, John Booth, Owen Lewis, Trevor Williams, Gary Staines, Roger Alsop, John Bicourt, Colin Bond, Jon Coy, John Mather, Marcello Bizio, Chris Millbank and Pete Gardner. Front row: Mike Nouch, Charles Dickinson, Stuart Paton, Don Anderson, M.Mazzotta, Mike Webb, Matt Kinane, John Wasbrough.
